moments.title: The ask: a standalone two-hour session on mutual funds alone
moments.summary: Asked what people would want next, a participant asks for a short standalone session — a two-hour thing on just mutual funds — and says she would really come back for that. She raises it in the context of an organisation discussed earlier, so it reads as a corporate ask as well as a personal one.
moments.evidence: I would love if you know you had something like a just a two-hour thing maybe just mutual funds yeah I would really come back for that for the mutual funds
